verdict.rationale: SumUp runs a first-party managed MCP server (mcp.sumup.com/mcp) that lets AI assistants act on SumUp APIs on the user's behalf: managing the account, creating checkouts and processing payments. An Agent Toolkit extends the same tools to LangChain, AI SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK and MCP agents, so an AI-native user can drive the product through natural language via an assistant. missing for 10: no native in-product natural-language interface (it relies on an external MCP client), no detail on which operations are covered beyond the headline ones, no hands-on or independent corroboration.
